svg.title: The DREADD method in steps: a DNA construct carrying a fluorescent tag (GFP) and the DREADD gene (hM3/hM4) is packed into a viral vector, a harmless virus carrying the gene; this is injected into the brain, where target neurons make the receptor; CNO, given orally or by injection, then acts on the receptor to switch the neurons on (hM3) or off (hM4).
